definitions: Operational allocation is provincial school-year funding, not audited actual spending and not all-source school expense.
Public system covers public, separate, Francophone and charter authorities. ECS pupils count as persons, not half-FTE.

Use Lloydminster-excluded rows for safest matched comparison: Alberta funding is a provincial contribution to cross-border divisions; geographical headcount is not necessarily resident funding eligibility.
Do not divide 2026-27 allocations by a previous-year headcount.
Use complete September-August monthly CPI averages for per-student purchasing power; 172.2 is the 2025 calendar-year reference index only.

education_function_definition: Expense by function education; excludes childcare classified Social Services. Includes postsecondary, K12 and education spending in other ministries. Capital amortization included, capital investment cash spending not added.
